tasks.title: Replace handoff choice lists with an actionable resume overview
tasks.description:
Outcome: A useful project resume overview instead of asking the user to remember a handoff.

Current implementation: Phase-scoped handoffs and preparation/read-back/verification already exist, but a list of several capsules does not orient a returning user.

Implementation responsibility:
- Combine current owned work, ready returns, blockers, next-work reasons and verified phase handoff summaries in a compact resume projection.
- Keep work status, source availability and integration separate. Show why alternatives are excluded and where a phase was left.
- Open the exact phase capsule for detail, preserving prepare/write/show/verify and archive behavior; a supporting Markdown file is not a resume-ready claim.
- Use project/caller/workspace scope and bounded continuation; do not redeliver all phase/feature documents for each recap.

Acceptance and evidence:
- A cold returning user can select the justified next step without remembering refs.
- Only read-back-verified persisted capsules are actionable; terminal archives remain discoverable as history.
- Unavailable/ambiguous ownership or source evidence stays explicit.

tasks.title: Coordinate complete context delivery and freshness-aware reuse
tasks.description:
Outcome: Complete context restoration with revision-aware reuse and bounded delivery.

Current implementation: Project/phase/task read gates exist; a historical timestamp can survive compaction and is not proof the model retained the content.

Implementation responsibility:
- Prepare applicable project rules/requirements/decisions, task/phase/feature and needed precedents through server operations, using context revisions distinct from activity changes.
- Persist caller/entity/context-revision records only for actually completed delivery; internal SQL reads and snippets do not satisfy full reads.
- Restore after supported reset/compaction/harness/workspace changes and provide explicit restoration where hooks are unavailable. Worker reads are independent of orchestrator/UI reads.
- Deliver only missing/stale mandatory content, with continuation and honest incomplete status; recheck revisions and ownership at task start.
- Consume T496 impact receipts to invalidate relevant evidence and measure comparable resume/no-op/high-fan-out payload/token/tool budgets.

Acceptance and evidence:
- No required rule/requirement/decision is silently omitted to meet a budget.
- Context changing between prepare/start blocks or requests only the changed content.
- Receipts prove delivery, not understanding/conformity or retention after context loss.
